snippet.title: Den of Wolves Gameplay Trailer | Future Games Show 2025
snippet.description:
Dive straight into chaos in the new Den of Wolves gameplay trailer premiered at Future Games Show. When the job hinges on how fast you can pull the trigger, there's no time for pause or mercy.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818140/Den_of_Wolves/

Den of Wolves is a co-op heist FPS from the creator of Payday, Payday 2 and GTFO. Execute contracts with your team in dynamic operations, from stealth to full-on action and back in mind-bending scenarios.

Find out more:
https://denofwolves.com

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/denofwolves
